svg.aria-label: Four phases over forty days, one developer: foundation on days 1 to 6, core clinic work to day 18, the eleven features to day 32, timeline, plans and hardening to day 40, with the dependencies that fix the order.
svg.text: Twelve days, one lane, one developer
96 hours at 8 a day. Tag main and run the collection green at the end of every block, then compare with the other two students.
THE DEPENDENCIES THAT FIX THAT ORDER
get req.clinicId wrong and all eleven features leak one clinic's patients to another
they all point at a patient, so it cannot wait
the honest wait time is this clinic's own average, not a typed-in number
they only aggregate what already exists, so they are built last
written while the plan table is in front of you, used nine days later
Lose a day and move the end date. Twelve hours tomorrow costs more quality than the missed day cost you — there is nothing here to absorb it.
